question:
I have a table that contains dates for different products. Each row on this table represents a ticket/issue and the start and end date for the tickets. Each product can have multiple tickets, and the dates can overlap as seen below.

The question I'm trying to answer is, "Was there a ticket for a given day?". I thought this would be most easily done by trying to select rows so that the dates don't overlap, but I'm unsure how to do this.

Here is an example of what it starts as.

id start_date end_date product_id
128981 10/8/2024 10/12/2024 756
125654 10/9/2024 10/9/2024 756
129034 10/12/2024 10/15/2024 756
127171 10/13/2024 10/13/2024 756
127796 10/15/2024 10/15/2024 756

And this is what I would like to have selected.

id start_date end_date product_id
128981 10/8/2024 10/12/2024 756
129034 10/12/2024 10/15/2024 756

How would I be able to construct a select query to do this?
title: How to select rows that don't have overlapping dates
answer:
The old thread that @Jorge Campos shared is indeed helpful as your 1st focus is to identify and group overlapping ranges then you try to select the minimum start date and maximum end date of each continuous range within each product_id.

I used a CTE to group overlapping rows and check if the start_date of the current row is within the end_date of the previous row for the same product_id if not, it starts a new group.

WITH DateRanges AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        product_id,
        -- Create a group for each continuous date range
        SUM(CASE WHEN start_date <= LAG(end_date) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY start_date) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) 
            OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY start_date) AS range_group
    FROM 
        tickets
),
AggregatedRanges AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(id) AS id,
        MIN(start_date) AS start_date,
        MAX(end_date) AS end_date,
        product_id
    FROM 
        DateRanges
    GROUP BY 
        product_id, range_group
)
SELECT * 
FROM AggregatedRanges
ORDER BY product_id, start_date
